en: A yellow postcard from the Museum of Physical Education and Sports in Budapest. The left side shows a circular image of a sports medal labeled with the number 6. At the top left are bilingual headings in Hungarian and English. At the bottom left is information about an exposition of sports medals held in 1987. On the upper right is a purple Hungarian postage stamp depicting a historic building, with a circular cancellation mark featuring a running athlete and the text of the museum and Budapest around it. Address lines are printed on the right-hand side.
